title: Canonical restriction of constant module sheaves to a slice
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], $U$ an object, $B$ a commutative ring and $M$ a $B$-module. Write $\underline M_{\mathcal C}$ and $\underline M_{\mathcal C/U}$ for the sheafifications of the constant module presheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], regarded as modules over the corresponding constant ring sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. There is a canonical natural isomorphism $\underline M_{\mathcal C/U}\simeq(\underline M_{\mathcal C})|_U$ on the localized site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Its composite with the constant presheaf sheafification unit on $\mathcal C/U$ is the restriction of the unit on $\mathcal C$. It is natural in $B$-linear maps $M\to N$, so a constant linear map restricts to the same constant linear map under these isomorphisms.
